artwork: Approved Pocket notebook with dark brown cover, cream pages and background, straight horizontal closure strap, and lowercase markdown note wordmark.

icon.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Create the taskbar/app-icon version of the attached APPROVED "markdown note" logo. The supplied image is the edit target and strict design reference. Preserve the notebook design exactly: compact upright rounded dark espresso brown book cover, cream page crescent on the right, and the straight horizontal right-side closure strap with parallel level edges and a softly rounded rectangular left end. Keep its existing gentle asymmetry and proportions.
Remove the wordmark completely. NO text, letters, symbols, labels or alternate versions.

Taskbar presentation:
One square icon asset, icon only, NOT a presentation board. Use a warm cream rounded-square tile behind the dark brown notebook, matching the approved cream background, with genuinely transparent pixels OUTSIDE the rounded-square tile. This cream tile is part of the icon and keeps the brown book visible on dark and light Windows taskbars.
Tile occupies approximately 94% of the square canvas, centered with consistent 3% outer transparent margin. Corners gently rounded, radius about 20% of tile width.
Notebook fills around 75% of tile width and 79% of tile height, centered and optically balanced. The straight closure strap projects slightly right as in the approved design.
Strong small-size legibility: flat dark brown (#40261e) and warm cream (#fff3d4) ONLY. Make the cream separator around the horizontal strap clear and uniform, approximately 2% of tile width, so it survives downsizing. Keep page strip substantial. No new details.
Completely flat vector-like artwork with crisp antialiased edges. NO gradients, shadows, lighting, bevels, reflections, textures, 3D, outer stroke, or drop shadows. Keep the approved book design, do not replace with a generic notebook.
Final: single high-resolution square icon, cream rounded tile, transparent exterior, no wordmark.

wordmark.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied "markdown note" notebook logo. Make ONLY a small local geometric refinement to the horizontal dark brown closure strap at the right-hand side of the notebook.
User request: "can we make the strap a bit more straight", pointing at its upper right edge.

Straighten the strap: its long top and bottom edges must be completely straight, parallel, and level horizontally. Use a simple broad horizontal rounded rectangle with modest corner radii; straighten the left end into a near-vertical gently rounded end instead of the current slanted taper. No curved bow, upward slope, or perspective tilt in the strap. Keep the strap attached on the RIGHT, extending leftward across the cover at the same height, same approximate length and thickness. Preserve the narrow cream outline/gap around the strap where it crosses the cover.

Everything else is invariant: exact same dark espresso brown cover; same cream page crescent and background; same notebook outer silhouette, scale and position; same exact lowercase "markdown note" wordmark, same font, letter shapes, spacing, size and position; same overall square canvas and whitespace. Do not redesign the logo, redraw the lettering, add details, introduce colors, or alter the background. Retain the image's existing appearance outside this small strap region. Output the edited image only.
